highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 renderer with current upstream correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback may select a different face after this engine update; applications needing deterministic selection should specify or bundle their typeface.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on an exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or bundle the required typeface.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and includes subsequent upstream m153 servicing and correctness fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream bug fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the 4.153 preview line for broader validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the HarfBuzzSharp native package build configuration for the 4.153 release line.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It brings the current upstream renderer and its associated correctness fixes to the new release line.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m153 line for validation.
